task.title: Run migrations and source-update checks
task.shortdesc: Apply database migrations and verify the updated BPM source deployment after the source revision changes.

prereq.p: The checkout and dependencies have been refreshed successfully, and the database backup evidence was collected while BPM was stopped.

context.p: Updates may introduce database migrations. BPM documents forward migration with alembic upgrade head; it does not promise automatic downgrade or safe schema rollback. A supported older ESR is not migrated automatically. Only when a future candidate actually retires an ESR can its declared immediate successor be migrated by the reviewed Alembic upgrade, after backup and read-only preflight gates.

step.cmd: Apply database migrations to the intended database only after the approved upgrade preflight is complete.

info.p: Use the actual deployment value for BPM_DATABASE_URL. For a retired-ESR upgrade, stop BPM and other writers, create and restore-check a native backup in a distinct clean candidate, then complete the database-specific read-only preflight before this command. Stop immediately if migration output is unclear or fails.

step.cmd: Start the updated BPM process and verify its current interface.

info.p: Check health and readiness, then open the Library route. If documentation is required for the deployment, confirm that /help/ reports a ready installed artifact rather than a missing or incompatible state.

step.cmd: Stop on migration or runtime verification failures.

info.note: After a migration has run, do not assume Git checkout rollback is enough. Do not run alembic downgrade for a retired-ESR migration. Restore the verified pre-upgrade backup into a new clean candidate, inspect it read-only, and rerun the reviewed upgrade there; never repair an ambiguous or partial candidate in place.

result.p: The updated source revision has completed migrations and runtime verification, or the update has stopped at a named failure point.

postreq.p: Start BPM and run the post-update verification topic before handing the instance back to users or integrators.
